decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions and kiosk hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the proposed extensions and kiosk, because of their compatible design, size, position and appearance, would not have a negative effect the viability of the adjoining retail units or harm the character and appearance of the Treaty Centre, and would not generate an additional parking requirement or have a harmful effect on servicing. The proposed improvements would contribute to the regeneration of Hounslow Town Centre and would maintain sufficient access for those with impaired mobility. The proposal complies with policy IMP.2.2 (Regeneration of Hounslow Town Centre), ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), S.3.1 (New Retail Development) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Development) of the Council's Adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Extensions to Library and unit 24-25 and creation of new kiosk to existing shopping centre.
